title: Hazel and the Smile
author: Silas Crane
blurb: Oscar Ashgrove, a pest controller called to something with fingerprints, keeps the lights on and the doors counted. Then the excavation crew unearths a door, sealed from the inside — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must learn the song's last verse without singing along before the harvest moon rises.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
